obfuscation_indicators: inherently uncertain and subject to refinement
risk_summary: The disclosure presents strong revenue and adjusted earnings growth, liquidity access, and operational continuity, creating a generally positive tone. However, COVID-19 exposure, uncertain customer-site closures, vaccine effectiveness, supply-chain risks, investment volatility, and judgment-heavy acquisition accounting introduce meaningful uncertainty. Extensive non-GAAP adjustments and forward-looking language may reduce comparability and obscure underlying earnings volatility.
